title: Transfer Status Response
description: Current status of the requested transfer.

status.description: Current status of the transfer. Most transfers are `complete` immediately; a `pending` transfer progresses to `complete`, `rejected`, or `failed`. `requested` is a transient state callers are unlikely to see.

transaction_id.description: Identifier of the transaction. May be null while the transfer is still being processed or if it did not complete successfully.

metadata.description: Request metadata included in every response.

method.description: The HTTP method used for the request.

timing.description: Time in seconds for the service to process the request.
